note: i.MX6ULZ (U1, BGA289 0.8mm) + DDR3 x16 (U2, BGA96) SBC on 50x50mm 4-layer. U1/U2/J4/H1-H4 seated by the intent's fixed_poses[].

groups.name: core
groups.why: the SoC with the decaps of its supply balls (SOC/ARM/HIGH/SNVS/USB caps, NVCC_PLL, +3V3 NVCC decaps), its NVCC_DRAM (VMEM) and DRAM_VREF decaps (U1's VMEM balls G6-M6 and VREF P4 are 10 mm from U2's), the FB2/FB3 beads that feed VDD_HIGH_IN / VDD_ARM_SOC_IN with their bulk caps (a supply bead goes with the one chip it feeds), the DDRCTL ZQ resistor R16, and the 24 MHz crystal Y1 with its load caps (claimed by place_simple anyway), and the SOC_ONOFF pull-up R2 at U1 R8 (a strap resistor goes at its MCU pin); and the MCP1700 point-of-load LDO U8 (+5V -> VDD_SNVS_IN) with its 1u in/out caps C19/C20: its output feeds U1 P12 (VDD_SNVS_IN, whose only decap is C20 -- pass 1 left that pin >8.46 mm from it in 11/12 seeds) and U5 EN, so it sits at U1 (a single-load LDO goes with its load)

groups.name: dram
groups.why: the DDR3 x16 with the decaps of its VDD/VDDQ (VMEM) balls, the VREF divider R13/R14 with its caps (VREFCA H1 / VREFDQ M8), the 470R CLK0 termination R1 and its ZQ resistor R15

groups.name: power

templates.why: TLV62568 1.5 MHz buck, +5V -> +1V2 (VDD_ARM_SOC_IN via FB3); datasheet SLVSD89B Figure 20
TLV62568 1.5 MHz buck, +5V -> +3V3; datasheet SLVSD89B Figure 20
TLV62568 1.5 MHz buck, +5V -> VMEM (DDR3 1.35V); datasheet SLVSD89B Figure 20

groups.why: the three TLV62568 bucks from +5V (1V2 core, 3V3, VMEM), each with its 4.7u input cap, 2.2uH inductor, output bulk cap, FB divider and PG pull-up; U5's PG (V3P3_PG) sequences U4/U6's EN

groups.name: power_in
groups.why: the +5V entry header (a cable entry: kept at the north edge)

groups.name: boot_cfg
groups.why: boot-configuration straps: pull-up/pull-down pairs on BOOT_CFG1/2/4 (U1's east-side LCD/boot balls) and the 4-way DIP SW2 with its 1k pull-ups on BOOT_CFG1_0/5/6/7

groups.name: boot_mode
groups.why: the BOOT_MODE0/1 DIP switch with its two 10k pull-ups (U1 T10/U10, west side)

groups.name: reset
groups.why: LM809 reset supervisor with its VCC decap C16, the RST_DLY pull-down R67 and 1k series R3 to SOC_RST_L, the reset cap C17 and push button SW3

groups.name: io_south
groups.why: the cable connectors served by U1's south balls: JTAG J2, FTDI UART1 J3 with its 22R series pair, UART2 J6 with its 22R series pair, I2C2 J7 with its 1.5k pull-ups

groups.name: storage
groups.why: microSD J4 (declared pose) with its VDD decap C60, and the QSPI flash connector J5; both are served by U1's north-east balls (SD1 A2-C2, QSPIA A3-E6)
